            for c in range(8):
                if b[r][c] == player:
                    pieces.append((r, c))
        
        if not pieces: return 0
        
        visited = set()
        count = 0
        for p in pieces:
            if p in visited: continue
            count += 1
            q = [p]
            visited.add(p)
            while q:
                curr_r, curr_c = q.pop(0)
                for dr in [-1, 0, 1]:
                    for dc in [-1, 0, 1]:
                        if dr == 0 and dc == 0: continue
                        nr, nc = curr_r + dr, curr_c + dc
                        if 0 <= nr < 8 and 0 <= nc < 8:

                                visited.add((nr, nc))
                                q.append((nr, nc))
        return count

    # Helper to evaluate board state
    def evaluate(b):
        my_c = count_components(b, PLAYER)
        opp_c = count_components(b, OPPONENT)
        
        if my_c == 1: return 100000
        if opp_c == 1: return -100000
        
        score = (opp_c - my_c) * 1000
        
        # Center control heuristic
        my_dist = 0
        opp_dist = 0
        for r in range(8):
            for c in range(8):
                if b[r][c] == PLAYER:
                    my_dist += max(abs(r - 3.5), abs(c - 3.5))
                elif b[r][c] == OPPONENT:
                    opp_dist += max(abs(r - 3.5), abs(c - 3.5))
        score += (opp_dist - my_dist) * 2

        rows = [0]*8
        cols = [0]*8
        diag1 = [0]*15 # r-c + 7

                    rows[r] += 1
                    cols[c] += 1
                    diag1[r-c+7] += 1
                    diag2[r+c] += 1
